help.title: Help & Guide
help.subtitle: Learn how to use every feature of Viora Dashboard.
help.overview_desc: This guide walks you through every section of the system — from managing children and staff, to tracking finances and generating reports. Click on any section below to learn more.
help.section_dashboard_desc: Your main overview with key metrics and charts.
help.dash_step_1: View total children count, unpaid students, total income, and net profit at a glance from the stats cards at the top.
help.dash_step_2: The bar chart shows your monthly financial performance — blue bars represent income, pink bars represent expenses.
help.dash_step_3: The pie chart gives a quick visual of how many students have paid vs unpaid tuition.
help.dash_step_4: Recent transactions are listed at the bottom — showing the latest 5 income/expense entries with amounts and dates.
help.dash_step_5: Click your profile card (top corner) to edit your profile, change your password, or log out.
help.section_children_desc: Add, edit, and track student enrollment and payment status.
help.children_step_1: Click 'Add Child' to register a new student — fill in name, age, group, parent details, phone, and monthly fee.
help.children_step_2: Click the edit icon on any child row to update their information (name, group, parent, etc.).
help.children_step_3: Record payments by clicking the payment button — choose cash, wallet, or bank transfer and enter the amount.
help.children_step_4: Use the search bar to quickly find a child by name or parent name.
help.children_step_5: Children are sorted by payment status — Paid students appear first, then Partial, then Unpaid.
help.staff_step_1: Click 'Add Staff' to register a new employee — enter their name, role, phone, and monthly salary.
help.staff_step_2: Click 'Pay' to process an employee's full monthly salary. Once paid, the button changes to 'Paid' (تم الدفع).
help.staff_step_3: Click 'Deduct' to record a salary deduction — enter the amount and an optional reason.
help.staff_step_4: Edit any employee's details by clicking the edit icon on their row.
help.section_finance_desc: Track all income and expense transactions.
help.finance_step_1: Click 'Add Transaction' to log a new income or expense — fill in description, amount, category, and date.
help.finance_step_2: Transactions are categorized (Tuition, Salaries, Supplies, etc.) for easy tracking and reporting.
help.finance_step_3: Click 'Export to CSV' to download all transactions as a spreadsheet for external accounting.
help.finance_step_4: View the full transaction history sorted by date — with color-coded indicators for income (blue) and expenses (pink).
help.reports_step_1: Click 'Current Month' to view a live report with real-time data from all sections.
help.reports_step_2: Click 'Export Bilingual Audit (PDF)' to print a formal 4-page accounting report in Arabic & English.
help.reports_step_3: Archived reports appear in the left panel — click any to review past months' financial records.
help.reports_step_4: All reports display currency in EGP with bilingual labels (e.g. Total Revenue / إجمالي الإيرادات).
help.section_settings_desc: Configure defaults and perform system maintenance.
help.settings_step_1: Set default values for child fees, staff salaries, and payment due dates to speed up data entry.
help.settings_step_2: Use 'Reset Monthly' to mark all children as Unpaid at the start of a new month (profiles are kept).
help.settings_step_3: Use the danger zone options carefully — 'Clear Finances' removes all transactions, 'NUKE EVERYTHING' deletes all data.
help.section_profile_desc: Edit your account details and security.
help.profile_step_1: Click your profile card → 'Edit Profile' to change your display name.
help.profile_step_2: Upload a profile photo — click the avatar circle and select an image (max 200KB).
help.profile_step_3: Change your password by entering a new password (minimum 6 characters) and confirming it.
help.profile_step_4: Logout safely — a confirmation dialog will appear before signing you out.
help.tip_1: Switch between Arabic and English at any time using the language button in the sidebar.
help.tip_2: Use the search bars on Children and Staff pages to quickly find records by name.
help.tip_3: Export your financial data regularly as CSV for backup and external accounting software.
help.tip_4: Print monthly reports at the end of each month for official record-keeping and signatures.
